'''Tarneel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who headed the [[Peace Brigade]] on [[Ord Sedra]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During the [[Battle of Ord Sedra]], he was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] by [[Kyle Katarn]] and taken into custody.

==Behind the scenes==
Although not named in the comic, Tarneel was named in the script. Author [[Nathan Butler]] named the character after the [[Wikipedia:North Carolina Tar Heels|Tar Heels]].<ref name="ChronoRadio">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsfanworks.com/chronoradio/crse2.html|text=ChronoRadio: Special Edition II: The Making of a Tale|work=[http://starwarsfanworks.com The Works of Nathan P. Butlet]|archivedate=20151017182211|nolive=1}} {{C|49:08}}</ref>
